deterministic_ordering: sort periods and canonicalize pair identity by series identity
population_sample_convention: Pearson coefficient uses sums of deviations; population/sample covariance scaling cancels in r
threshold_justification: Retained 1990-2024 annual fixtures have at most 34 first differences; 30 preserves raw Pearson v1's minimum evidentiary intent while allowing one-period transformation loss and limited retained missingness. This validation accepts the threshold for bounded companion production; future broader source classes may require revalidation.

transformation_contract.gap_behavior: t and t-1 must be consecutive annual periods; do not bridge gaps using previous available observation
transformation_contract.missingness_behavior: missing when either endpoint is missing or invalid
transformation_contract.non_finite_behavior: non-finite inputs or outputs fail closed
transformation_contract.period_label_semantics: transformed observation is labeled by ending period t and represents change from t-1 to t
transformation_contract.unit_semantics: absolute year-to-year first differences; never percent growth, percent change, growth rate, or elasticity
